decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) a coherent multi-axis drop around indices 485–544 with a plateau-like U behavior, and (2) a sharp multi-component shift starting near 605–610 with incomplete recovery. Both show ambiguous superposed changes and lack definitive opposing returns within the observed windows.

regions.observation: Cross-axis shape shows a multi-sample abrupt drop in N and E around index 490–495, followed by sustained low-amplitude oscillation; U component exhibits a broad shallow platform from ~495 to 520 before resuming variability. The drop appears coherent across axes but lacks a clear opposing return within the window.

Strong, rapid shift in all three components beginning near index 610: N drops sharply (~+2.8 to -5.2), E shifts from positive to strongly negative (~+2.3 to -1.6), and U falls from ~6.1 to ~-0.5 over ~5 samples. A possible partial recovery begins around index 630 (U rises, N/E remain low), but no full return is evident in this window.
